name: Swiggy Limited
summary: Swiggy Limited runs the Swiggy platform, through which customers in India browse, order and pay for food delivery. Its segments include food delivery, quick commerce, out-of-home consumption, supply chain and distribution, and platform innovation. Related services include grocery delivery through Instamart, restaurant reservations through Dineout, event bookings, pick-up and drop-off, and hyperlocal commerce.
